_what: Where /approve reads and sends a root declaration, on the same origin as the sign-in pages (the engine answers them): `current_path` answers the person's current root ({fingerprint, root}, or 404 {error: no_root} when they have none), `proposed_path` + a fingerprint answers a proposed root's document, `signature_path` takes {signature, root}. `first_root`: the page after the first passkey makes the person's first root when `current_path` says there is none. `summary_fields`: the fields of a row that name it in the change shown, first one present.
